chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Husayn al-Ahmasi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
If the people were to neglect the Hajj, they would not be respited of the punishment, or he said: The punishment would descend upon them.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence if people neglect the Hajj pilgrimage according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) emphasizes the Hajj as a vital communal obligation whose neglect invites divine retribution, reflecting the Shia scholarly view of its role in preserving the unity and spiritual integrity of the Ummah. The slight ambiguity in the transmission regarding whether punishment is withheld or inflicted underscores the gravity of the ritual as a primary means of averting calamity. This highlights the practical implication that consistent performance of Hajj is not merely personal piety but a collective safeguard against divine wrath.
